description: A forest guardian blessed by the ancient oaks of Thornhaven, who channels the living pulse of the woodland to mend allies. Roots and vines answer their call.
icon_hint: oak staff entwined with green healing vines and soft golden glow
card_prompt: Pixel art, SNES style. A decorative card frame background for a fantasy warden nature healer class. Gnarled vine-wrapped bark border with small green leaves at corners. Warm heartwood grain center with soft golden-green healing glow. Small glowing oak leaf cluster at bottom. Color palette: warm bark brown, verdant green, golden glow. No characters, no text.
